steps.name: precheck-host
args: SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version, current_setting('server_version') AS server_version, current_setting('shared_buffers') AS shared_buffers, current_setting('work_mem') AS work_mem, current_setting('maintenance_work_mem') AS maintenance_work_mem, current_setting('effective_cache_size') AS effective_cache_size; SELECT left(pg_read_file('/proc/cpuinfo', 0, 20000), 20000) AS cpuinfo_prefix; SELECT left(pg_read_file('/proc/meminfo', 0, 12000), 12000) AS meminfo_prefix;
